docs.bases/authoring/calendar.md:
# Calendar view

The calendar view lays a base out on a month grid.

## Writing a calendar base

Set `view: calendar` and name the date property in `dateProp`. Each row with a date becomes an event on the grid; rows without one are listed under the grid.

## Colours

Event colours come from the colour property.
docs.tasks/syntax.md:
# Task syntax

## Bracketed fields

A task parses only bracketed fields such as `[due 2026-09-14]` and `[high]`.
